claims.text: The proposed model combines gating mechanisms and tensor products to learn long-term dependencies and improve interaction between input and hidden layers.
The architecture includes Long Short Term Memory (LSTM) and Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU) models integrated with tensor products for enhanced expressiveness.
